meta.title: About — Our Story & Team | CampusSphere
meta.description: Discover the story behind CampusSphere, the student team building the platform, and our mission to make university life more connected and collaborative.
meta.ogDescription: Go behind the scenes of CampusSphere, the platform built by students to connect and energize campus life.
meta.schemaDescription: The academic and collaborative social network built for students.

hero.lede: CampusSphere started with a simple belief: succeeding at university should never depend on being lucky enough to sit in the right WhatsApp group. We bring notes, peer help, and projects together to carry your semester forward.

pillars.title: Born between lectures
pillars.desc: An idea sparked in 2025 from real student experience, built to organize and help each other all year.

pillars.title: Everything in one place
pillars.desc: Lecture notes, solved tutorials, past exam papers, project spheres, clubs, and AI-assisted revision.

pillars.title: Built with students
pillars.desc: Every tool evolves from direct feedback on campus to match the real rhythm of your semesters.

story.lede: Not an idea born in a boardroom, but a practical answer to the hurdles students face every semester across lectures, exams, and group assignments.

steps.title: An idea born between classes
steps.desc: The idea for CampusSphere began in 2025 from a simple reality: as students in Cameroon, we wanted a tool built for our real campus life, not just another distracting social feed.

steps.title: Everything was scattered
steps.desc: Notes buried across ten WhatsApp groups, missing past CA and exam papers, messy group work, and missed club announcements: we lacked one reliable shared hub.

steps.title: Bringing it all together
steps.desc: We built CampusSphere to unite peer support, study resources, project spheres, campus events, and AI revision — so every student can progress with confidence.

mission.card1Body: Make academic resources and peer support simple, open, and natural for every student — regardless of major or study level.
card1Points: Keep lecture notes, solved tutorials/practicals, and past exam papers circulating
Make it easy to connect across batches, majors, and academic seniors
mission.card2Body: Establish CampusSphere across Cameroonian campuses before expanding across Africa: a living ecosystem supporting you from Year 1 all the way to your first career opportunities.
card2Points: Connect universities, higher institutes, student clubs, and associations
Open doors to academic internships, conferences, and concrete projects

q1.q: How do I create an account on CampusSphere?
q1.aText: Click Sign up at the top of the page and follow the 3 quick steps: your basic details, your academic profile (school, major, study level), and your interests or skills.
q1.a: Click <link>Sign up</link> at the top of the page and follow the 3 quick steps: your basic details, your academic profile (school, major, study level), and your interests or skills.

q2.q: What is the minimum age required to sign up?
q2.aText: Access to CampusSphere and Sphera is reserved for users aged at least 16. Between 16 and 18, registration requires prior consent from a parent or legal guardian, in accordance with our Terms of Use.
q2.a: Access to CampusSphere and Sphera is reserved for users aged at least <bold>16 years old</bold>. Between 16 and 18, registration requires prior consent from a parent or legal guardian, in accordance with our <link>Terms of Use</link>.

q3.q: Can I edit my details after signing up?
q3.aText: Yes, you can update your personal details, major, study level, profile photo, and bio anytime directly from your profile by clicking Edit Profile.
q3.a: Yes, you can update your personal details, major, study level, profile photo, and bio anytime directly from your profile by clicking “Edit Profile”.

q4.q: How do I verify my student account?
q4.aText: Verification can be completed either using your valid institutional email address or by submitting proof of enrollment (student ID card or registration certificate) reviewed by our team.
q4.a: Verification can be completed either using your valid institutional email address or by submitting proof of enrollment (student ID card or registration certificate) verified by our team.

q1.q: What is a Sphere on CampusSphere?
q1.aText: A Sphere is a community workspace dedicated to a course, major, batch, group project, or student club. You can ask questions, share study materials, and follow discussions without losing information across ten different chats.
q1.a: A Sphere is a community workspace dedicated to a course, major, batch, group project, or student club. You can ask questions, share lecture notes, and follow discussions without losing key information in endless chat threads.

q2.q: How do I join an existing Sphere?
q2.aText: Go to the Spheres tab, search for your school, subject, or club, then click Join. Public spheres open immediately, while private spheres require approval from a moderator.
q2.a: Go to the “Spheres” tab, search for your school, subject, or club, then click “Join”. Public spheres open immediately, while private spheres require approval from a moderator.

q3.q: Can I create my own Sphere?
q3.aText: Yes, every registered student can create a Sphere for their class, project group, or student club. You choose its visibility (public or private), description, and internal rules.
q3.a: Yes, every registered student can create a Sphere for their batch, study group, or student club. You choose its visibility (public or private), description, and internal rules.

q4.q: How does moderation work inside a Sphere?
q4.aText: The Sphere creator and the moderators they appoint manage members, approve or remove posts, and ensure everyone follows our Community Guidelines.
q4.a: The Sphere creator and the moderators they appoint manage members, approve or remove posts, and ensure everyone follows our <link>Community Guidelines</link>.

q5.q: How does the Impact Score work?
q5.aText: The Impact Score rewards genuine peer help on the platform: sharing useful study notes, helping a classmate, contributing in spheres, or supporting campus life increases your score. See all details on the dedicated Impact Score page.
q5.a: The Impact Score rewards genuine peer support on CampusSphere: sharing useful study notes, helping a classmate, or keeping spheres active grows your score. Explore the full breakdown on the <link>Impact Score</link> page.

q1.q: What is Sphera and how does it help me study?
q1.aText: Sphera is the AI-assisted revision workspace built into CampusSphere. From your study materials (PDFs, notes, past exam papers), it generates clear summary sheets, interactive quizzes, revision cards, and targeted practice for your CAs and final exams.
q1.a: Sphera is your AI-assisted revision workspace built into CampusSphere. From your study materials, it generates <b1>clear summary sheets</b1>, <b2>interactive quizzes</b2>, <b3>revision cards (flashcards)</b3>, and targeted practice based on your past exam papers.

q2.q: Do I need a second account to use Sphera?
q2.aText: No! CampusSphere and Sphera share one unified account. Once you are signed in to CampusSphere, you can access Sphera directly without registering again.
q2.a: No! CampusSphere and Sphera run on a single unified account. Once you are signed in to CampusSphere, you can access Sphera directly without creating a second account.

q3.q: Are my uploaded notes used to train public AI models?
q3.aText: No. Your documents and prompts are processed in isolated, secure AI environments (AWS Bedrock and Google Cloud). They are never used to train public models and remain strictly confidential.
q3.a: No. Your documents and prompts are processed inside secure, isolated AI environments (including AWS Bedrock and Google Cloud). They are never used to train public models and remain strictly confidential.

q4.q: Does Sphera work for all academic fields?
q4.aText: Yes, Sphera automatically adapts to the content of your document whether you study sciences, engineering, computer science, law, economics, management, medicine, or humanities.
q4.a: Yes, Sphera automatically adapts to your document’s subject matter — whether you study sciences, computer science, engineering, law, economics, management, medicine, or humanities.

q1.q: What is the difference between the Library and Shared Resources?
q1.aText: The Library gathers structured past exam papers, reference textbooks, and curated materials. Resources brings together revision sheets, summaries, solved tutorials, and lecture notes freely shared among students.
q1.a: The Library gathers organized past exam papers, reference textbooks, and verified materials. The Resources space brings together revision sheets, summaries, solved tutorials, and lecture notes freely shared among students.

q2.q: Which file formats can I upload and where are they hosted?
q2.aText: You can upload standard formats (PDF, DOCX, TXT, and images). Files are stored encrypted and securely on Amazon Web Services (AWS S3) with strict access controls.
q2.a: You can upload standard formats (PDF, DOCX, TXT, images). All files are stored encrypted and securely on Amazon Web Services (AWS S3) with strict access control.

q3.q: What should I do if a document infringes copyright?
q3.aText: We strictly respect intellectual property. If a document infringes your rights or a lecturer's rights, report it from the document menu or write to policies@campussphere.app for swift removal.
q3.a: We strictly respect intellectual property. If a document infringes your rights or those of a lecturer, report it from its menu or email <mail>policies@campussphere.app</mail> for prompt removal under our <link>Copyright Policy</link>.

q1.aText: Yes, CampusSphere's core features are free: profile, campus feed, study spheres, messaging, events, and resource sharing. For heavier AI usage on Sphera (large generations or advanced models), optional AI passes and credit packs are available.
q1.a: Yes, CampusSphere’s core features are free: profile, campus feed, spheres, messaging, events, and resource sharing. For intensive AI usage on Sphera, optional passes and AI credit packs are available.

q2.aText: To stay simple and accessible for students, payments are processed via Mobile Money (MTN Mobile Money, Orange Money) through the secure Campay gateway.
q2.a: To stay simple and accessible for every student, payments work via <b1>Mobile Money (MTN MoMo, Orange Money)</b1> through the secure <b2>Campay</b2> payment gateway. Check our <link>Terms of Sale</link> for full details.

q3.q: Can I get a refund after buying credits or a pass?
q3.aText: Access to digital credits or passes starts immediately after Mobile Money confirmation; therefore, consumed credits or started passes are non-refundable. In case of a verified technical payment issue, contact support@campussphere.app.
q3.a: In accordance with our <link>Terms of Sale</link>, digital service activation is immediate upon Mobile Money confirmation: consumed AI credits or started passes are non-refundable. If a verified technical error occurs on a Campay transaction, contact our support team at <mail>support@campussphere.app</mail>.

q1.q: How are my data and study notes protected?
q1.aText: Your traffic is encrypted in transit over HTTPS (TLS 1.3) and your data is encrypted at rest (AES-256) on our cloud infrastructure powered by Supabase and Amazon Web Services (AWS EC2 and AWS S3).
q1.a: Your traffic is encrypted in transit via HTTPS (TLS 1.3) and your data is encrypted at rest (AES-256) on our cloud infrastructure powered by Supabase and Amazon Web Services (AWS EC2 and AWS S3).

q2.q: Is my personal data sold to third parties?
q2.aText: No. Your data is never sold, rented, or handed over to ad networks. It is only processed by our essential technical providers (Supabase, AWS, secure AI models, Campay).
q2.a: No. Your data is <bold>never sold, rented, or shared with advertisers</bold>. It is only processed by our essential technical providers (Supabase, AWS, Campay), in full compliance with our <link>Privacy Policy</link>.

q3.q: How do I permanently delete my account and data?
q3.aText: You can permanently delete your account anytime from your profile settings or by following the steps on our Data Deletion page. Your personal details, private files, and histories are permanently purged.
q3.a: You can permanently delete your account anytime from your profile settings or by following the instructions on our <link>Data Deletion</link> page. Your personal information, private documents, and histories are then purged from our systems.

q1.q: What new features are coming soon to CampusSphere?
q1.aText: We are progressively preparing the Student Marketplace (academic gear exchange), the native mobile app, and a mentorship & opportunities hub to support your journey even further.
q1.a: We are progressively preparing the Student Marketplace (exchanging academic equipment), the native mobile app, and a mentorship & opportunities space to support your student journey even further.

q2.q: Which email address should I contact?
q2.aText: For technical support, bugs, or Mobile Money payment issues: support@campussphere.app. For legal, privacy, or copyright matters: policies@campussphere.app. For campus partnerships, press, or general inquiries: contact@campussphere.app.

meta.title: Impact Score: Scoring & Tiers | CampusSphere
meta.description: Discover how the CampusSphere Impact Score works: sharing resources (+5 pts), peer impact ratings (+1 to +5 pts), and 5 progression tiers.
meta.ogDescription: On CampusSphere, the Impact Score rewards the real usefulness of your shared materials and peer support on campus.
meta.twitterDescription: Official scoring system, anti-spam rules, and 5 progression tiers for the CampusSphere Impact Score.

hero.titleLine2: the true measure of your peer support.
hero.lede: On CampusSphere, value isn’t measured by vanity likes or post volume. The Impact Score rewards what genuinely helps your classmates succeed.

p1.title: Per shared resource
p1.desc: Every lecture note, solved tutorial, or past exam paper you share moves your score forward.

p2.title: Peer impact rating
p2.desc: Classmates rate your post from 1 to 5 based on how much it actually helped them.

p3.title: From Newcomer to Legend
p3.desc: Your profile tier evolves automatically as you contribute across the platform.

rules.lede: A simple, transparent, cheat-proof scoring model: only genuinely helpful contributions raise your score.

r1.title: Sharing a study resource
r1.desc: Credited directly to your profile as soon as you share a useful document (revision sheet, lecture notes, solved tutorial, or past exam paper) in Resources or a Sphere.

r2.title: Peer impact rating
r2.desc: On every feed post, students can tap for +1 or press and hold to choose a rating from 1 to 5 depending on the real help provided.

r3.title: Real-time recalculation
r3.desc: If a student adjusts their rating (for example from 5 to 2) or removes it, the difference updates immediately. Your total always reflects active votes.

zeroRules.title: What intentionally earns 0 points
zeroRules.desc: These actions are excluded from scoring to prioritize quality and prevent spam.

z1.title: Publishing a regular post
z1.reason: Rewards usefulness rather than posting volume to keep campus feeds free of spam.

z2.title: Posting a comment
z2.reason: Prevents low-effort replies posted solely to inflate a score counter.

z3.title: Downloading a file
z3.reason: Only an explicit rating after reading confirms genuine academic quality.

z4.title: Rating your own posts
z4.reason: Strictly disabled: only fellow students can raise your Impact Score.

levels.lede: Each milestone you cross automatically upgrades your status on your profile and highlights your contribution to fellow students.

future.lede: The Impact Score won’t just stay a badge on your profile: practical utilities and exclusive perks are rolling out progressively on CampusSphere.

f1.title: Perks & privileges
f1.desc: Unlock reserved opportunities, highlighted contributor badges, and exclusive access within your campus community.

f2.title: Direct utility
f2.desc: Your accumulated points will become actively usable to boost your study tools, revision sessions, and interactions.

f3.title: Get a head start
f3.desc: Every revision sheet shared and every impact rating earned today puts you ahead as soon as new rewards launch.

faq.ledePrefix: Everything you need to know about using the Impact Score day to day. Looking for more answers? Explore the

q1.q: How do I rate a post’s impact on the campus feed?
q1.a: Every post has a lightning button. A quick tap awards +1 impact point. Pressing and holding (or hovering on desktop) reveals a bar to pick an exact rating from 1 to 5.

q2.q: Can my Impact Score go down?
q2.a: Your score never decays over time. It grows with every shared resource and every peer rating received. It can only decrease if a student lowers or removes their vote, or if a non-compliant document is removed.

q3.q: How does the Impact Score affect the campus feed?
q3.a: CampusSphere naturally highlights posts that help the community most. Quality notes, summary sheets, and useful advice stay visible longer.

q4.q: Will I be able to use my Impact Score points in concrete ways?
q4.a: Yes! Practical utilities and exclusive privileges for active contributors are in the works. Building your score now means enjoying them as soon as they launch.

q5.q: Where can I see my tier and progress?
q5.a: Your Impact Score and progress bar toward the next tier appear right on your profile.
